fees.protocolFee: feeBps of provider gross (to treasury); 0 on reject/refund
fees.evaluatorFee: evaluatorFeeBps of provider gross (to evaluator) on settled Complete/Partial when the verdict stands; 0 on reject, overturn, instant release
fees.arbitrationFee: IArbitrator.arbitrationCost(jobId, amount) quoted at challenge time (jobId 0 = prospective quote); challenger pays it with the bond; held by the escrow/adapter until the ruling (E-17a); paid to the arbitrator inside rule(); on a material ruling the losing side reimburses the challenger (evaluator stake on verdict path, provider bond on instant path); on a stale dispute refunded to the challenger

erc8183Adapter.role: evaluator address named by an external ERC-8183 kernel; a staked evaluator in EvaluatorRegistry makes the decision

expiryBound.rule: kernel expiredAt >= now + evalWindow + challengeWindow + arbitrationTimeout + expiryMargin at assign and at acceptAssignment (E-1a)
views: quote(uint256 budget) -> (challengeBond, arbitrationCost, requiredExpiry, minKernelExpiry, configVersion)
expiryBound.lateSubmission: E-1c refuse: if the submission is first observed (noteSubmission or verdict) when expiredAt < now + requiredExpiryDuration(pinned version), no eval window starts: state -> ExpiryRefused, ExpiryRisk(id, expiredAt, requiredExpiredAt) emitted, evaluator exposure released, no slash; the kernel job falls to the kernel's own refund path (claimRefund after expiry). ExpiryRisk is only ever emitted together with this refusal.

erc8183Adapter.mapping: payoutBps >= completeThresholdBps -> kernel.complete, else kernel.reject (lossy: ERC-8183 has no partial outcome)

accepts.settle: EscrowDepositRouteFactory.settle(offer, from, value, validAfter, validBefore, nonce, signature) -> atomic only: executes transferWithAuthorization then opens the escrow job with client = from; reverts if the authorization was already used (A-1e)

accepts.note: A-1e (v0.1.2 k-of-n): the only way to credit funds that reached a route outside the atomic settle. EscrowDepositRouteFactory.attestDeposit(offer, txHash, logIndex, from, value, refundOnly) -> (credited, jobId, refunded) is a VOTE by an allowlisted keeper (isKeeper). Votes are keyed by transferId = keccak256(abi.encode(txHash, logIndex)) and must agree on digest = keccak256(abi.encode(route, from, value, refundOnly)); the deposit is credited by the threshold-th (k, default 2 of n = 3) matching vote of distinct current keepers in the current keeperEpoch (AttestationRecorded per vote; DepositAttested(route, transferId, from, value, jobId, refunded, fromVault) on credit). A vote with a different digest freezes the deposit (DepositFrozen; status Frozen; further votes revert DepositIsFrozen). claimOf(id) -> {digest, epoch, round, count, status None|Pending|Credited|Frozen}; hasAttested(id, keeper); attested(id) == Credited. value == offer.amount and !refundOnly opens a job for `from` (refund if it cannot open); otherwise refunds `from`. If the route no longer holds value (swept), the route balance is flushed into the RecoveryVault and the claim is paid from the vault (refund only, fromVault = true; reverts InsufficientUnclaimed beyond the route's unclaimed funds). Keeper set and threshold: deploy-time, then proposeKeeper/executeKeeper and proposeThreshold/executeThreshold after keeperTimelock (default 48h); every executed change bumps keeperEpoch, which discards all pending (not frozen) votes (AttestationRoundReset); k <= n re-checked at execution; k < 2 only on chainId 31337/1337/11155111/84532 (ThresholdBelowTwoOnProductionChain otherwise).

A-1e v0.1.2: a Frozen deposit is resolved only by the factory owner through the keeper timelock: proposeResolution(id, Credit|Reset, route, from, value, refundOnly) (ResolutionProposed, eta = now + keeperTimelock), cancelResolution(id), executeResolution(id, offer) by anyone after eta (DepositResolved). Credit pays exactly like a k-th vote with the given values (route must match the offer: WrongRoute); Reset returns the claim to None and starts a new voting round. OPEN QUESTION: owner trust; arbitration alternative not built (ASSUMPTIONS A-1e).

A-1a/A-1d/A-1e v0.1.2: startSweep() is keeper-only (any single keeper) and snapshots the balance; credits during the delay are deducted from the snapshot; sweep() is permissionless after sweepDelay (default 30d) and moves min(snapshot, balance) to route.sweepTo() == the factory's RecoveryVault (immutable per route; never the treasury directly), recorded as unclaimed[route]. Events SweepStarted, Swept, FlushedToVault.

RecoveryVault (one per factory, address = factory.vault()): unclaimed[route], totalUnclaimed, lastSweptAt[route], releasableAt(route). Payers claim swept attributable Transfers through the same k-of-n attestDeposit (paid from the vault, at most once per (txHash, logIndex), never more than the route's unclaimed funds). releaseExpired(route), anyone, after lastSweptAt[route] + horizon (default 365d, factory Config.recoveryHorizon; every sweep into the vault restarts the route's horizon) sends the route's unclaimed funds to the treasury (ReleasedToTreasury). payout is factory-only; recordSweep route-only. Tokens sent to the vault directly are unattributed and stay there (OPEN QUESTION).

A-1b/A-1e v0.1.2: agent/scripts/keeper.mjs --keeper 0|1|2 (local, trusted allowlisted keepers Anvil #7/#8/#9) scans token Transfer logs to watched routes; acts only on logs at or below the safe head = latest - confirmations (default 2, AGENTCOIN_KEEPER_CONFIRMATIONS / --confirmations) and, where the RPC supports it and not on Anvil, the `finalized` block; re-checks the receipt's blockHash against the canonical chain; verifies the log off-chain (token emitter, to == route, from, value, no DepositSettled in the same tx, from != 0); skips Credited, Frozen and already-voted claims; then votes attestDeposit. Action kinds: pending-finality, reorged-out, vote-recorded, credited-job, credited-refund, credited-vault-refund, frozen, frozen-awaiting-resolution, already-voted, already-attested, unattributable-mint, atomic-settled, swept-to-vault, sweep-started. Trust: docs/SECURITY-NOTES.md. Alternative without keepers (evaluated, not built; no exact-committed scheme): docs/A-1e-commitment-routes.md
